domain_title: Accountability, evidence, risk decisions and lifecycle governance
title: Monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement
canonical_definition: Quality, risk, security, impact and compliance are monitored; incidents and material changes trigger response, reassessment, reauthorization or controlled retirement.

conditions: Deployment, Operation and Monitoring, Review and Evaluation, Retirement, and every material-change reassessment trigger.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are monitoring objectives, incident thresholds, material-change triggers, review cadence and retirement duties defined?
Are telemetry, incident workflows, reassessment, rollback, decommissioning, deletion and vendor exit implemented?
Do operational records show timely detection, response, reauthorization and complete retirement when required?

capability_indicators: Retirement removes access and data while preserving decisions

conditions: Refer a material failure of monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.5 (PDF p. 28), GOVERN 1.7 (PDF p. 28), MANAGE 4.1 (PDF p. 38), MANAGE 4.3 (PDF p. 38)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on maintaining monitoring and periodic review, responding to incidents and planning decommissioning. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: F5 evaluates monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement using evidence from intent through operation. AP-F5 independently assesses evidence of approval-as-end-state governance.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies an operating and retirement plan specifying monitoring coverage, incident thresholds, change triggers, review cadence and exit obligations. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates telemetry and triage, reassessment on change, authorized rollback, decommissioning and provider-exit controls. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides dated monitoring, incident and change exercises or operational records demonstrating reauthorization and retirement completion where due. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide an operating and retirement plan specifying monitoring coverage, incident thresholds, change triggers, review cadence and exit obligations. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate telemetry and triage, reassessment on change, authorized rollback, decommissioning and provider-exit controls. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide dated monitoring, incident and change exercises or operational records demonstrating reauthorization and retirement completion where due. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with an operating and retirement plan specifying monitoring coverage, incident thresholds, change triggers, review cadence and exit obligations. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use dated monitoring, incident and change exercises or operational records demonstrating reauthorization and retirement completion where due to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: An explicitly limited operating approval can be valid when monitoring, review and expiry remain active.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-F5 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement
Evidence remains insufficient for monitoring, incidents, change, re-evaluation and retirement in the assessed scope
